kids_evidence: Grocery list/allergen app for households; category SHOPPING (store/apps/GroceryMatch.json:36); Kids Category audit n-a (docs/store-policy/GroceryMatch.md:50).

interstitial.why: AglAds.onTransition() after the user's own 'Finish trip' (lib/features/trip/trip_screen.dart:242). It is the least-bad trigger (the spec allows it only there, specs/GroceryMatch.md:214), but this is a task-focused shopping utility used at the checkout with allergen/health information, so the founder rule says remove. If the founder wants the revenue, this is the only acceptable spot.

native.screen: lib/features/stores/stores_screen.dart (StoresScreen, list view of nearby supermarkets)
native.why: Nearby-store results from OpenStreetMap (up to 25, lib/services/location/nearby_grocery_service.dart:89,107) are a listings/results list. One small native after the 8th store, only when more than 8 are visible, outside the store tile styling (it sits inside a bordered Container of _StoreTile rows separated by DashedRule - put the ad between rows with its own spacing so it cannot pass as a store). Not in History (personal trip records), list, trip mode, scan or Basket check (spec forbids ads there, specs/GroceryMatch.md:143, :214). Note the same screen already has the bottom banner; cap at 1 native.

rewarded.existing_limit_or_quota: none (basket checks are cached 24 h per item to limit API calls - lib/services/basket/basket_check_service.dart:17-19 - not a user quota)
rewarded.why: No user-facing quota, premium or IAP (grep premium|in_app_purchase|paywall: no hit). Basket check and allergen swaps are core, health-related features and must not be gated. Nothing honest to reward.

blockers: pubspec.lock pins agl_ads at d5e5b72, which predates agl-manifest cb21ee5 (git merge-base --is-ancestor: not contained); run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd/showRewarded.

agl_ads AglAds.initialize() preloads an interstitial on every launch even if the app never calls onTransition (packages/agl_ads/lib/src/ads.dart:94 `unawaited(_loadInterstitial());`). Removing the onTransition call does not stop that request; agl_ads needs an opt-out (e.g. a configure flag) or the app keeps sending one unused interstitial request per launch. (applies once the trip_screen.dart:242 call is removed)

store/ratings/GroceryMatch.json does not exist, so tooling falls back to store/ratings/default.json:16 "advertising": false although the app ships AdMob; apps with ads that have their own file say true (e.g. store/ratings/TripNest.json:16). Not verified what App Store Connect currently holds.
